Sam (People Ops): Quick note — temporary transit relief measures for SF hub next two weeks. Read if youre planning to be onsite or host visitors. :mega:

Sam (People Ops): Whats changing: 1) flexible hours window (6:30 10:00 arrival, 15:30 19:00 departure) to avoid commute peaks, 2) limited daily daypasses for guests (max 30), 3) carpool & ride subsidy available for employees commuting from East Bay. Links: daypass form https://redwood.internal/forms/sf-daypass and subsidy sign-up https://redwood.internal/commute/subsidy

Ivy (Facilities): Weve reserved 10 visitor desks across north wing and 4 quieter rooms for demos. Badge pickup stays in lobby; visitors need prereg confirmation.

Ravi (Eng): How do teams request the quieter rooms for a demo?

Dana (People Ops): Use the usual room booking flow but include "demo-room: SF-pilot" in the notes. Well prioritize if you indicate an external customer.

Ravi (Eng): Ride subsidy — how does that work?

Sam (People Ops): Subsidy covers up to $15 one-way for eligible commutes for the pilot period. Submit receipts in Expensify with tag "SF-Transit-Pilot". For carpools well reimburse gas for registered drivers (drivers must register vehicle plate with Facilities).

IT Support: If contractors need network access while onsite, open a ticket with "Guest wifi" and include contractor name + visit dates. Temporary accounts valid for pilot period only.

Taxi Bot: Shuttle remains at 8:00 inbound and 6:30 outbound. Additional on-demand shuttle runs will be scheduled if demand exceeds capacity. Sign-up link above.

Ivy (Facilities): Note: parking is very limited. If you need parking for a customer, put the request in daypass form and allow 48h notice.

Ravi (Eng): Any change to desk booking window?

Sam (People Ops): Yes — for the pilot weve opened bookings 10 days in advance to help teams coordinate with visitors.

Dana (People Ops): Pilot dates: Mon 4/12  Fri 4/23. Well review metrics (desk utilization, shuttle fills, daypass requests) end of week 1 and adjust. DM #people-ops or @Sam with questions. :thumbsup:
